node.statement: The level-one part follows by unpacking compressed-product-display: S_P nonzero is the nonvanishing alternative, and S_P is then an O(e)-C*-algebra; its epsilon-Banach product upper axiom applied to Z^dagger and Z, together with ||Z^dagger||=||Z||, gives ||Z^dagger dot Z|| <= (1+kappa_1*e)||Z||^2 with universal witnesses after a universal threshold restriction.
